description.text: VSTAR & VMAX High-Class Deck Zeraora, a 60-card Lightning deck released on 15 July 2022 with Deoxys's: two Zeraora VSTAR, two Zeraora VMAX and four Zeraora V, which can evolve into either, with Flaaffy and Thundurus reprinted as holo to attach Lightning Energy. Both decks brought the new Pokémon Tool Leafy Camo Poncho, which protects a Pokémon VSTAR or VMAX from the effects of the opponent's Supporters, and came with a VSTAR marker, damage counters and markers, a player's guide and a coin showing their Pokémon.
